sourceRefs.locator: No. 1, pp. 1–2: opening list of protected people and church property; injunction on ring-sealed episcopal letters for captives taken under the king’s peace and the truth of petitions.
BK 1, Date and Transmission. Boretius dates the royal letter 507–511; the manuscripts place it in the canonical tradition.

summary.de: Ein in Abschriften erhaltener königlicher Text über den Schutz bestimmter Personengruppen, Gefangene und die mit Siegelringen beglaubigten Schreiben von Bischöfen.
summary.en: A royal text surviving in copies on the protection of certain groups, captives and letters authenticated with bishops’ signet rings.
